correctness.rationale: For distinct Fourier row frequencies a,b modulo N, the full frame operator is N/2 times identity, and any r-mask has retained eigenvalues (N-r±|z_E|)/2. The gcd phase map splits N labels into m=N/g equal-capacity classes. Maximization of |sum c_j ζ_m^j| by a support-functional projection fills the cyclic largest-cosine arc; a strict convexity argument rules out split boundary partial counts. Hence q full consecutive classes, at most one s-partial adjacent class, formula M=|g sum_{j<q} ζ_m^j+sζ_m^q|, count m when s=0, m*C(g,s) for endpoint q, 2m*C(g,s) for interior q; all endpoints and m=2 covered. I independently exhaustively enumerated erasure masks and verified maximal moduli and equality counts for all 3<=N<=10, all differences and all sizes (372 test triples). The all-N proof is the exact exchange/convexity argument, not that finite test.
